answer_1.quote: We propose a novel unified benchmark for ARabic natural language GEeneration (ARGEN) composed of seven tasks: machine translation, code-switched text translation, summarization, news title generation, question generation, paraphrasing, and transliteration.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text for Arabic NLG tasks including translations, summaries, titles, questions, paraphrases, and transliterations

answer_2.quote: Results of ARGEN MT are reported in Table. Results show that our models achieve best BLEU score in 37 out of the 42 tests splits.
